periods.time: C-block first round of the 62nd Seven Stars Sword-Art Festival

name.zh: 无冕剑王VS七星剑王第一轮
name.en: Uncrowned Sword King versus Seven Stars Sword King

periods.summary: Ikki fights reigning champion Yudai Moroboshi in the first round. Moroboshi repeatedly controls the match with spear range, Sanrensei, Hahakiboshi and an improved Tiger Bite that can damage Devices. Ikki eventually synchronizes with the Edelweiss-derived movement in his body, overwhelms Moroboshi's speed, and defeats him after seeing through Moroboshi's final thrown Tiger King trap.
periods.cause: The tournament bracket places Hagun captain Ikki against defending champion Moroboshi in C-block's fourth first-round match.
periods.process: Ikki first tests whether the freezing symptom remains. Moroboshi lures him with apparent spear weaknesses, reveals Hahakiboshi's chasing thrusts, then uses Tiger Bite to chip Intetsu. Ikki counters with Shinkirou but freezes at decisive moments. Near defeat, he recalls Edelweiss's zero-to-max sword movement and begins moving too fast for Moroboshi to see. Moroboshi endures, hears Koume's renewed cheer, and sacrifices part of Tiger King to throw a Tiger Bite-coated spear at Ikki's predicted path. Ikki anticipated that the champion would still have a counter and uses vertical Shinkirou to dodge and strike from above.
periods.outcome: Ikki wins and advances to round two. Moroboshi collapses but entrusts Ikki with the request not to lose. The crowd recognizes Ikki as a true contender for the Seven Stars crown.
periods.significance: The volume's main duel; it proves Ikki can contend nationally, awakens his post-Edelweiss sword movement, ends Moroboshi's reign, and lets Koume speak again.
